data.name: Anash
data.gender_notes: Anash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Anash is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Anas' which means 'Breath' or 'Life'. This name signifies the vital energy that sustains all life forms. In Hindu mythology, the god Anash is believed to be the embodiment of the life force, nourishing and protecting all beings. The name Anash carries the meaning “Breath of Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anash usually hope their child will grow to embody breath of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anash belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breath of Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anash total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
